description.value: La Pache Pizza is a proudly Canadian, multi-location pizzeria specializing in authentic Neapolitan-style handmade pizza with dough made fresh from scratch daily. The New Westminster location on East Columbia Street is one of several Lower Mainland outposts, offering meat, vegetable, and vegan pizza options available for online ordering and takeout. A straightforward stop for a hot meal mid-ride.

address.value: 323 East Columbia Street, New Westminster, BC
